commands.title: Vyntra: Fix Selected Code or Diagnostics
Vyntra: Connect to Remote Ollama Host

localNest.maxContextFiles.description: How many workspace files to include as context for a question (top matches by name/content).

localNest.model.description: Default Ollama model. Any model Ollama supports works (qwen, llama, codellama, deepseek-coder, etc.) — the chat panel lists the models actually pulled on your host and lets you switch.

localNest.ollamaHost.description: Ollama base URL. Keep localhost for fully local use, or point it at your own remote Ollama host. This extension sends code only to this host, and has no GPU/CUDA settings — Ollama manages hardware itself and runs on CPU by default.

localNest.provider.description: Model provider: free local Ollama only — no Gemini, no API key.

localNest.geminiModel.description: Gemini model ID. gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-2.5-flash are listed by default; any other Gemini model ID set here is also passed straight to the Gemini API.

localNest.geminiApiKey.description: Optional fallback for the Gemini API key. Prefer the secure command “Vyntra: Set Gemini API Key”, which stores it in Secret Storage instead of settings.

localNest.lowBandwidth.description: Low-bandwidth / slow network: smaller workspace context and smaller model replies.

localNest.autoFallback.description: If the selected provider is unreachable on this network, automatically try the other provider (Gemini <-> Ollama) before giving up.

localNest.temperature.description: Model temperature: 0 = precise/deterministic code, 0.2 = default for coding, 1 = creative, up to 2 = wild. Applies to Ollama, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers.

localNest.openaiBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. LM Studio http://localhost:1234/v1, OpenRouter https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, Groq https://api.groq.com/openai/v1.

localNest.openaiModel.description: Model ID for the OpenAI-compatible provider, as that provider names it.

localNest.openaiApiKey.description: Optional fallback for the OpenAI-compatible API key. Prefer the secure command Vyntra: Set OpenAI-compatible API Key, which stores it in Secret Storage instead of settings.

localNest.agentMaxRounds.description: Agent verify-and-fix step ceiling (the agentic loop). 5 by default; set higher for long tasks, lower for quick ones.

localNest.agentMaxGeneratedTokens.description: Max generated tokens per model reply. 0 uses 4096 in low-bandwidth mode, otherwise 8192.

localNest.agentTaskTimeoutMs.description: Agent task elapsed-time budget in milliseconds. 0 = no timeout.

localNest.agentMaxFileBytes.description: Maximum bytes for a single file the agent may write (8 MiB ceiling). Larger proposed files are refused, not truncated.

localNest.historyCharacters.description: Conversation history character budget before old messages are moved to older-chat retrieval.

localNest.chatMemory.enabled.description: Keep conversation history and retrieve relevant older messages for a new turn (lexical match; raw tool results are excluded).

localNest.chatMemory.resultCount.description: Maximum older-chat messages retrieved for a new turn.

localNest.chatMemory.retrievedCharacters.description: Maximum characters per retrieved older-chat message.

localNest.chatMemory.scope.description: Chat memory scope: 'current' keeps memory per workspace, 'all' shares it across workspaces in this editor.

localNest.contextMaxFileBytes.description: Maximum bytes per indexed workspace text file. Larger files are skipped.

localNest.contextMaxIndexCharacters.description: Total retained source-text character limit for workspace indexing.

localNest.contextMaxIndexedFiles.description: Maximum eligible text files retained in the workspace index.

localNest.ollamaContextWindow.description: Ollama num_ctx. 0 leaves it to Ollama/model default; set explicitly only after checking RAM/VRAM.

localNest.ollamaMaxOutputTokens.description: Ollama num_predict. -1 leaves generation uncapped by this extension (model context and hardware still apply).

localNest.ollamaAgentThinking.description: Request internal reasoning from thinking-capable Ollama models. Reasoning is not displayed as chat.

localNest.ollamaAutoStart.description: If on, try to start an already-installed local Ollama server when it is offline. Never downloads software or models, never starts a remote service.

localNest.openAICompatibleUrls.description: Comma-separated OpenAI-compatible API base URLs. The first reachable one is used for the OpenAI-compatible provider. No credentials in this list.

localNest.routing.agentModel.description: Preferred model id for Agent/Build tasks. Leave blank to use the provider's default model.

localNest.routing.chatModel.description: Preferred model id for Ask/Plan chat. Leave blank to use the provider's default model.

localNest.routing.editModel.description: Preferred model id for edit/fix selection tasks. Leave blank to use the provider's default model.
